notes: The Hearth Chest on the Great Hearth's ledge (the Burning Tower, Tyler 2026-11-14; lane/a-tower-art 2026-11-16). The style-1 iron-bound chest the cottage ships (cell 1 of PixelLab image 75c00296, its shipped palette-locked pixels) with its one latch replaced by four lock plates, one in each key's metal (Bronze, Silver, Gold, Platinum), as the locked story has it: 'one big chest on the ledge, with a different lock for the better ones'. Its 8-frame idle is the Hearth fire's light on its right-hand iron (tools/world-art/tower-art.mjs FLICKER), so the ambient row loops on the town's clock. Placed by the town map's AMBIENT row on the hearth's front paving, left of the firebox (src/data/world/town/sites.js), and drawn only while the server sends the Tower's section.
